entries.name: Paper Expert
entries.text: You always have paper-based ninja tools to use.

entries.name: Hold Still
entries.text: When you cast a Ninjutsu that requires an attack roll, targeting a hostile creature that has moved less than 15 feet this round, your attack is made with advantage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Shikigami Genin may make one attack with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Kunai (Melee)
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Kunai (Ranged)
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

entries.name: Paper Bomb Affixed Kunai
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. Regardless of the attack result, all creatures within 10 feet of the target creature (including the target creature) must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d4 fire damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success. If this attack hits the target creature, the target creature makes its saving throw with disadvantage.

entries.name: Flash Tag Affixed Kunai
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: (1d4 + 1) piercing damage. Regardless of the attack result, all creatures within 10 feet of the target creature (including the target creature) must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature gains the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn. If this attack hits the target creature, the target creature makes its saving throw with disadvantage.
